remaining_cautions.evidence_context: DBAASP cytotoxicity rows use IC50 with ug/ml, while the reopened primary paper text reports GI50 values and no visible GI50 unit.

Primary text supports reference-strain and resistant-isolate antibacterial non-activity at MIC >256 ug/mL, but some database rows add exact ATCC/MDR subject precision not recoverable from the local paper text.
DRAMP sequence/topology metadata does not faithfully encode the primary-source cyclic nonstandard-residue structure; conflict preserved.
The paper reports phenotype-level activity/non-activity only; no direct mechanism claim is accepted.
